clone_and_source_tags.merge_clone: Nonadditive diagnostic overlap with merge-tagged rows; do not add to stored/number clone or exclusive partition.
clone_and_source_tags.number_clone: Nonadditive diagnostic overlap; generic allocator Box::clone is excluded by the final classifier.
clone_and_source_tags.stored_clone: Nonadditive intersection; matches the source-derived count/byte model in the three workloads, repeated at samples=3.

conservation: Raw decoder, size aggregates, trace-size aggregates, and heaptrack histogram pass calls/requested-byte checks for all six runs; standard folded export calls pass but has no requested-byte column.

stage_resolution.exact: stage_timed_commit rows are admitted when this callsite resolves
stage_resolution.interpretation: Either exact stage_timed_commit or the explicit commit-core surrogate is required with timed_iteration; both are selected whole-process allocation rows, not a phase-only allocation measurement.
stage_resolution.surrogate: MultiSourceEdit::commit is retained in a separately labelled commit-core bucket only for inlined/unresolved stage_timed_commit stacks
